LINE: headscale |
LISTED: [headscale <BEL> / api         -- Authentication towards the headscale API / completion  -- Print the completion script of a shell / debug       -- A health check and test tools / users       -- Manage users / version     -- Print the version / $ headscale ]
FINAL: [headscale ]

LINE: headscale ve|
LISTED: [headscale version ]
FINAL: [headscale version]

LINE: headscale api |
LISTED: [headscale api whoami ]
FINAL: [headscale api whoami]

LINE: headscale debug h|
LISTED: [headscale debug health ]
FINAL: [headscale debug health]

LINE: headscale completion |
LISTED: [headscale completion <BEL> / bash        fish        powershell  zsh        / $ headscale completion ]
FINAL: [headscale completion ]

LINE: headscale completion z|
LISTED: [headscale completion zsh ]
FINAL: [headscale completion zsh]

LINE: headscale completion bash |
LISTED: [headscale completion bash <BEL>]
FINAL: [headscale completion bash ]

LINE: headscale -|
LISTED: [headscale --]
FINAL: [headscale --]

LINE: headscale version -|
LISTED: [headscale version --]
FINAL: [headscale version --]

LINE: headscale version --|
LISTED: [headscale version --<BEL> / --config  -- Config file / --help    -- Show this help / --output  -- Output format: json / $ headscale version --]
FINAL: [headscale version --]

LINE: headscale version -c|
LISTED: [headscale version -c ]
FINAL: [headscale version -c]

LINE: headscale api whoami --|
LISTED: [headscale api whoami --<BEL> / --config  -- Config file / --help    -- Show this help / --output  -- Output format: json (the API object) / $ headscale api whoami --]
FINAL: [headscale api whoami --]

FINAL: [headscale -c ]

FINAL: [headscale --config=]

FINAL: [headscale version -o json --]

LINE: headscale completion bash -c|

LINE: headscale users |
LISTED: [headscale users <BEL> / create  -- Create a local user / get     -- Show one user / list    -- List the users / set     -- Change a local user / $ headscale users ]
FINAL: [headscale users ]

LINE: headscale users list --|
LISTED: [headscale users list --<BEL> / --columns       -- Columns to show: a list, or +name and -name to change the default / --config        -- Config file / --filter        -- Keep the rows that match; may be repeated / --help          -- Show this help / --list-columns  -- List the columns, the API field behind each, and exit / --output        -- Output format: json (the API object) / --sort          -- Column to sort by; -name sorts in reverse / $ headscale users list --]
FINAL: [headscale users list --]

LINE: headscale users list --columns id,na|
LISTED: [headscale users list --columns id,name]
FINAL: [headscale users list --columns id,name]

LINE: headscale users list --columns +lo|
LISTED: [headscale users list --columns +login-name ]
FINAL: [headscale users list --columns +login-name]

LINE: headscale users list --sort -co|
LISTED: [headscale users list --sort -count ]
FINAL: [headscale users list --sort -count]

LINE: headscale users list --filter=pro|
LISTED: [headscale users list --filter=pro<BEL> / profile-pic-url  provider         provider-id     / $ headscale users list --filter=pro]
FINAL: [headscale users list --filter=pro]

LINE: headscale users set alice --|
LISTED: [headscale users set alice --<BEL> / --config        -- Config file / --display-name  -- New display name; "" clears it / --email         -- New email address; "" clears it / --help          -- Show this help / --name          -- New username / --output        -- Output format: json (the API object) / --picture-url   -- New profile picture URL; "" clears it / $ headscale users set alice --]
FINAL: [headscale users set alice --]

LINE: headscale -h ve|
LISTED: [headscale -h version ]
FINAL: [headscale -h version]

LINE: headscale --version |
LISTED: [headscale --version <BEL> / api         -- Authentication towards the headscale API / completion  -- Print the completion script of a shell / debug       -- A health check and test tools / users       -- Manage users / version     -- Print the version / $ headscale --version ]
FINAL: [headscale --version ]
